title: Keepace.ai: A Technical Report on a Large Language Model for Sports and Health
abstract: arXiv:2610.38249v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Large language models hold promise for delivering safe, scientifically grounded, and personalized exercise guidance at scale, yet the sports-and-health domain still lacks curated training corpora and rigorous evaluation benchmarks. Keepace (Keepace.ai) is a domain-specialized LLM built on Qwen3.5-27B through post-training, currently optimized for Chinese-language exercise guidance across three tasks: workout plan generation, sports-and-health knowledge QA, and personal sports data analysis. In internal rubric-based evaluations designed with domain experts, Keepace outperforms its base model and larger general-purpose baselines, with the most pronounced improvements in exercise safety, boundary compliance, structured output completeness, and scientific accuracy. This report summarizes the current design, data pipeline, safety-first evaluation framework, and evaluation results of Keepace.

translated_title: Keepace.ai：一个面向运动与健康领域的大语言模型技术报告
translated_abstract: 大语言模型有望大规模提供安全、科学且个性化的运动指导，但运动与健康领域目前仍缺乏经过精心整理的训练语料和严格的评估基准。Keepace（Keepace.ai）是基于Qwen3.5-27B通过后训练构建的领域专用大语言模型，目前针对中文运动指导进行了优化，涵盖三项任务：健身计划生成、运动与健康知识问答以及个人运动数据分析。在与领域专家共同设计的基于评分量表的内部评估中，Keepace的表现优于其基座模型和更大的通用模型基线，其中在运动安全性、边界合规性、结构化输出完整性和科学准确性方面的提升最为显著。本报告总结了Keepace当前的设计、数据流程、安全优先的评估框架以及评估结果。
tldr: Keepace是基于Qwen3.5-27B后训练的中文运动健康领域专用大语言模型，在健身计划生成、知识问答和运动数据分析三项任务上超越了基座模型及更大的通用模型，尤其在运动安全性、边界合规性和科学准确性方面提升显著。
en_tdlr: Keepace is a domain-specialized LLM post-trained on Qwen3.5-27B for Chinese sports-and-health guidance, outperforming its base model and larger general-purpose baselines across workout plan generation, knowledge QA, and sports data analysis, with the most pronounced gains in exercise safety, boundary compliance, and scientific accuracy.
